title: De Erfenis van Pim: 87 Dagen Ruzie
original_title: De Erfenis van Pim: 87 Dagen Ruzie
overview: Ten years ago, the first Balkenende cabinet fell after just 87 days. A reconstruction of the political drama within the Pim Fortuyn List (LPF) that led to this inglorious downfall. The LPF leadership, including rivals Eduard Bomhoff and Herman Heinsbroek, look back on the most turbulent period in our parliamentary history.
